message: TCPXO plugin version detection found different plugin versions across the target nodes (v1.0.16, v1.0.17); rendering the images for v1.0.15, the minimum supported release and the one AICR pins (NCCL image nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:25.06-py3, training image nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:25.06-py3, tcpxo-daemon us-docker.pkg.dev/gce-ai-infra/gpudirect-tcpxo/tcpgpudmarxd-dev:v1.0.21). If the plugin is v1.0.17 or later, set categories[].options.image to a CUDA 13 image on the GCP H100 NCCL and training categories.
